newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka buys 12,500 t white rice from Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys 12,500 t white rice from Pakistan.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state buying arm, the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment, has bought 12,500 tonnes of white rice from Pakistan at $226.85 per tonne and freight free out of Colombo, government officials said on Friday.
The rice, from Qaiser Noman and Co Ltd, is for shipment before December 15, they said.
"We tendered for 37,500 tonnes but bought only one parcel because of delivery problems," said an official, who declined to be named. "We're negotiating with other traders for the rest."
